text: Absorbed duplicate bd-01M15TAQAZBRN41W3F2HKR9QX2 (chief's, closed). Its distinctive content, preserved here - THE REOPENING SIGNAL for the narrow adapter-owned fix ratified at post-01M15TAQ889V32VGE344MG2X40: revisit when EITHER a second provider must re-derive the same receipt context, OR a consumer outside embed-grakern must make a plain-versus-keyed decision it cannot ground from what it holds. Until one of those occurs, adapter-owned context is sufficient and this bead is a design question rather than a defect.
